captions.formal: A sequence of animated scenes begins with a view of pink clouds and green foliage, followed by a dark creature resting inside a grassy burrow. A white rabbit then appears on a green lawn, observing a pink butterfly before following it toward a large tree trunk. The clip concludes with a close-up of the white rabbit smiling against a backdrop of a yellow field and a pale sky.
captions.sarcastic: Witness the breathtaking odyssey of a white rabbit, who manages the Herculean task of waking up and staring at a butterfly. After a daring journey of several feet toward a tree, he reaches the pinnacle of his day by simply existing and smiling at the sky. Truly, the wildlife documentary of the century.
captions.humorous_tech: The white rabbit initiates a boot sequence from its burrow, transitioning from sleep mode to an active state on the grassy production environment. It spends several cycles debugging a pink butterfly object before attempting a merge with a nearby tree, eventually reaching a stable build with a satisfied smile. The entire process runs with high latency but zero critical errors.
captions.humorous_non_tech: A very round white rabbit decides that today is the day he will finally conquer the great outdoors, starting with a daring stare-down with a tiny pink butterfly. After a grueling trek across a few patches of grass to a tree, he celebrates his massive achievement by grinning like he just won the lottery. It is a high-stakes adventure for someone who is mostly made of fluff.
